label: Drone track toward Crocmaz (Aug 9)
damage: Wreckage embedded in tree line; no structural damage
notes: First UAV wreckage recovered on Moldovan territory since 2022; prompted ambassador recall from Moscow

label: Drone incursion over Priozerne, return to Ukraine (Aug 10)
notes: Detected by Moldova's Army Air Operations Service radar during a Russian strike on Odesa; exited Moldovan airspace north of Stepankivka

label: Drone track toward Talmaza (Aug 17)
damage: 2m-wide, 50cm-deep crater; forest fire across ~45x20m; no structures hit
notes: Ukraine's Air Force attributes the object to a Banderol-type drone; Moldovan investigators could not conclusively confirm the type

label: Shahed-136/Geran-2 track from Moldova into Romania, shot down near Galați (Aug 16)
notes: Downed by a Spanish F/A-18 Hornet on NATO Air Policing patrol; 4th drone shot down over Romania in 2026

label: Passportisation decree application channel: Moscow to Tiraspol
notes: Route by which Transnistria residents submit Russian citizenship applications via Russian consular missions under the May 15 decree

label: Moldova-Romania electricity interconnector
notes: EUR 270m EU/EIB/EBRD/World Bank-financed high-voltage link reducing reliance on Cuciurgan-generated power

label: Moldovagaz-Tiraspoltransgaz supply route to Cuciurgan
notes: Regulator-authorised gas supply arrangement via MET Group keeping the Cuciurgan plant partly gas-fired through Jul 1, 2026

label: EU-Moldova accession negotiation track
notes: Formal negotiation channel opened with the Fundamentals cluster (Jun 15) and External Relations cluster (Jul 14)

label: OGRF command line, Cobasna to Tiraspol
notes: Russian troop command structure restricted to Transnistrian territory after Chisinau's persona non grata declaration

label: Severed Moscow-Chisinau cultural diplomatic link
notes: Formal diplomatic/cultural channel terminated with the closure of the Russian Center for Science and Culture in Chisinau

label: Drone track toward Etulia, Gagauzia (Aug 19-20)
notes: Fourth confirmed Moldovan airspace breach since Aug 9; entered from Kotlovyna (Bolboka), Ukraine, exited toward Ukraine six minutes later

label: Shahed-138 track toward Caplani, Ștefan Vodă (Aug 22)
notes: Fifth confirmed Moldovan airspace breach since Aug 9; entered from Krutoiarivka, Ukraine, exited toward Ukraine 17 minutes later

label: Drone track via Vulcănești to Pașcani, exits toward Romania (Aug 24)
damage: None reported on Moldovan soil; drone components later found in Vrancea County, Romania, carried no explosive charge
notes: Sixth confirmed Moldovan airspace breach since Aug 9; entered near Vynohradivka, Bolhrad Raion (Odesa Oblast, Ukraine), crossed over Vulcănești in Gagauzia, exited near Pașcani (Cahul district) toward Romania, where two Romanian F-16s and an IAR-330 SOCAT helicopter were scrambled

label: Drone track via Palanca, exit toward Tudora (Aug 26)
notes: Seventh confirmed Moldovan airspace breach since Aug 9; entered near Palanca, exited toward Tudora/Hradenytsi, Ukraine, five minutes later

label: Five-drone overnight wave across Ștefan Vodă frontier (Aug 26-27)
damage: None reported from the airspace crossings themselves
notes: Five separate drones crossed the Ștefan Vodă frontier between 03:56 and 06:02 local time hours before Moldova's 35th Independence Day; represents the cluster of crossings near Bălăbănești, Palanca, Starokozache, Căplani and Săiți-Lisne
